whoami.title: whoami
whoami.heading: Backend / Fullstack Developer with hands-on production experience.
whoami.intro: I build, evolve, and maintain multi-tenant enterprise systems. My domain spans relational database modeling (MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite), backend development (PHP, Node.js, NestJS), application interfaces (Next.js, React, React Native, Angular), Linux infrastructure, SSH deployments, internal scripts, and AI agent-assisted workflows.
whoami.tagline: From database & backend logic to deployment and monitoring on Linux servers.
whoami.production: Hands-on experience on the production front line: investigating security incidents, reading logs, optimizing SQL queries, and automating tasks (Python/JS). I focus on delivering resilient code with end-to-end ownership.
quotes: From relational data modeling to Linux server deployment & security.

diff.minus: write code and ignore how it executes in production
